rows.note: Use 朋友 as the all-purpose noun for a friend or casual acquaintance.
Use 搭檔 when the person is your partner for a particular activity or task.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 hai6 tek3 bo1 daap3 dong2

rows.note: Use 兄弟 when informally addressing an unfamiliar man in a friendly or confrontational way.

example.english: Buddy, your car is really blocking the way here.
example.traditional: 兄弟，你部車泊喺度好阻喎。
example.jyutping: hing1 dai6 nei5 bou6 ce1 paak3 hai2 dou6 hou2 zo2 wo3
